block.vs_marine_propulsion.large_ship_pr: Applies thrust to the ship, dependent on the input speed.
block.vs_marine_propulsion.engine_order_: Allows to control output speed of linked _Variator_ blocks.
R-Click on a Variator block to place it under control,
R-Click to increase engine order, Shift + R-Click to decrease it.
block.vs_marine_propulsion.variator.tool: Controls output speed according to linked _Engine Order Telegraph_.
block.vs_marine_propulsion.rudder_bearin: Deflects attached _Rudder_ Blocks to provide steering to ships.
block.vs_marine_propulsion.rudder.toolti: Provides a means to steer a ship.
When deflected by a Rudder Bearing:
Applies steering torque to the ship, dependent on the speed and deflection angle.
R-Click on a Rudder Bearing block to place it under control,
R-Click to man the station, then use A/D to steer.
block.vs_marine_propulsion.diving_plane_: R-Click on a Rudder Bearing block to place it under control,
R-Click to man the station, then use A/D to steer.
